note: Chakraborty & Vafeiadis (POPL 2019) §4.3 state that Weakestmo and PS (1.0, the 2017 model they compare against) are incomparable, with a witness each way: Coh-CYC (PS allows, Weakestmo forbids) and FADD (Weakestmo allows, PS forbids). Both are semantic-dependency-preserving models that forbid out-of-thin-air and give external DRF. Weakestmo is built on event structures rather than promises and certification, and unlike PS it supports SC accesses. PS 2.0 added reservations to fix the RMW mapping problem that FADD exposes, so it is not established that the FADD direction still holds for PS 2.0, and PS 2.0 has no edge to Weakestmo.
